<!-- Example: I — Execution & OMS -->

<!-- One primary WP. If stacked, list explicit supporting dependencies separately. -->

<!-- Example: MIP-2 / M3 -->

<!-- S0 | S1 | S2 | S3 | S4 -->

## Objective
<!-- What invariant/outcome does this PR establish? -->

## Dependencies
<!-- Upstream PRs/WPs, runtime prerequisites, data/evidence dependencies. Write NONE when there are none. -->

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] No untracked safety/config/authorization changes

## Required Verification Rung(s)
<!-- V0 | V1 | V2 | V3 | V4 | V5. Higher safety classes inherit lower rungs. -->

## Evidence / Reports
<!-- CI runs, test receipts, evidence bundles, screenshots/reports where appropriate. Do not paste secrets. -->

## Migration / Rollback
<!-- State migration, compatibility, recovery, rollback/revert path. Write NOT APPLICABLE with reason for docs-only work. -->

## Production / Capital Impact
<!-- Explicitly state whether this changes PAPER/LIVE behavior, broker access, risk policy, environment authorization, or capital exposure. -->

## Safety Review
<!-- Required for S3/S4 and safety-critical execution/risk/broker paths. Include `[safety-review]` in the PR title for those changes. -->
- [ ] Safety reviewer required
- [ ] PAPER/runtime evidence required before adoption where applicable
- [ ] Explicit human authorization required for any LIVE/capital promotion
